tagline: The shared shopping list for your trip, with every item in the language of the country you are visiting.
onboardTitle: The shared shopping list for your trip
onboardText: Write down together what you need and tick it off in the shop. Abroad, the app also shows every item the way it is called in the shops there.
invitedTitle: You have been invited to a shared shopping list
invitedBy: {name} invited you to a shared shopping list
hintTranslation: Under each item you see what it is called in the shops of the travel country. Tap it to show it to the staff.
hintShare: Shopping with others? Share the list. Everyone sees the same list and writes in their own language.
whichLanguage: Which language do you write in?
knownMember: Already in this list? Tap your name:
removeListConfirm: ⚠️ The list disappears from your lists. It stays for the other members. You can rejoin with the link or QR code.
deleteListConfirm: ⚠️ You are the only member. The list and all its items will be deleted for good.
qtyMerged: {name} was already on the list: now {qty}
autoClearHint: Checked items disappear once you have left the shop, at the latest after 1 day. They stay available under “Bought before”.
deletedMany: {n, plural, one {# item removed} other {# items removed}}
demoMode: Demo mode: Supabase is not connected, lists stay on this device.
listNotOnDevice: This list is not stored on this device.
syncOffline: Offline – changes are saved and sent as soon as you are back online.
syncLocal: Only on this device – sharing is not connected.
empty: Still empty. Type an item in your language above.
help1: Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services: on, and for “Safari Websites” choose “While Using the App”.
help2: In Safari tap “aA” (or the page icon) in the address bar → Website Settings → Location: “Allow”. Then Safari stops asking every time.
photosNotFromShop: Nothing found for {shop}, common products in the country
membersHint: Anyone who opens the link becomes a member. Change your own name under “My profile” in the menu.
name: Name
countryChangeHint: Changes the country for everyone the list is shared with.
demoShare: Demo mode: without Supabase others cannot see the list.
openByLinkHint: Got a link to a list? Paste it here. On iPhone you need this if you use Cart on the Road from the home screen.
linkInvalid: That is not a link to a list.
qrScanHint: Hold the list’s QR code inside the frame
qrWrong: That is not a list QR code.
cameraDenied: No camera access. Allow it in your browser settings.
cameraUnavailable: This browser cannot use the camera.
iosHint: You are in the browser. Have Cart on the Road on your home screen? Then copy the link and paste it in the app under “Join a list”. Otherwise the list is missing there.
installHint: Tip: Add Cart on the Road to your home screen and it starts like an app.
installIos1: In Safari, tap the share icon (square with an arrow pointing up). If you don’t see it, tap “•••” first.
installIos2: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. You may need to scroll down.
installIos3: Tap “Add”. From then on, start Cart on the Road from the icon.
installIosLists: The home screen app has its own storage. To bring this list there, copy the link and paste it in the app under “Join a list”.
installAndroid1: In Chrome, tap “⋮” at the top right.
installAndroid2: Choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
installAndroid3: Confirm with “Install”. From then on, start Cart on the Road from the icon.
shareIosHint: iPhone with Cart on the Road on the home screen: tap “Join a list” → “Scan QR code” in the app and scan this code.
errNoGeo: This device cannot determine its location.
errOffUnreachable: Open Food Facts is unreachable or busy.
errOffStatus: Open Food Facts is not responding (error {status}).
correctionHint: Applies right away for everyone in this list and helps improve the dictionary.
locSheetText: “Automatic” changes the travel country with your location, for example on a round trip. For that, the app needs your location.
locSheetPrivacy: Coordinates are sent to OpenStreetMap and not stored on any server.
locSheetFixed: Without your location, the list cannot change the country by itself. Choose the travel country.
locSheetBlocked: Location is blocked in your browser settings, so the app cannot ask. Choose the travel country; “Automatic” works again once you allow location there.
autoCountryHint: Follows your location, except in a country of your own language.
feedbackFailed: Not possible right now (offline?). Please try again later.
